stem: After an authorized intervention, one leaf is clean but multi-round incidence continues to rise. What conclusion is defensible?
choices: The treatment succeeded because at least one leaf is clean.
The rising incidence should be deleted as preexisting damage.
The isolated clean observation does not support control success against the contradictory trend.
The follow-up can stop because the action was completed.
rationale: The isolated clean observation does not support control success against the contradictory trend.
